name: Amicro Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Amicro Technology Co., Ltd. robotics technology platform engaged in offering mobile robotics solutions, including inertial navigation robotic solutions, single-modal robotic solutions and multi modal robotic solutions in China. The company offers Amicro Core design and develops of dedicated system-on-chip (SoC) semiconductors for intelligent mobile robots, leveraging proprietary robotics technologies, mixed-signal chip design capabilities, robot perception systems, intelligent algorithms, sensors, and motion-control modules, Amicro provides full-stack robotics solutions used in applications such as cleaning robots and service robots.
